objective: Prove the frozen statement T1 to T4 for 6-regular tori (states as quasi-periodic heights with an admissible tilt; the margin M), with finite checks against every torus to 96 distinctions, and attempt Klein bottles.
status: Proved, refereed twice: on every 6-regular torus (two-sided balanced two-fold weave) with margin M, states exist exactly when M >= 0, bond distance >= min(d, M/3) + 1 with equality d + 1 when d < M/3, faithful when M > 3; the same on edge-glide Klein bottles (pairs directed so every knot is a directed cycle, Lemma K0), Theorem K; altitude glides not proved. Checks C1 to C12 passed.
title: The ruler on tori, by winding heights
